title: V1.5 report turns 3-4: direct amounts and certificate date, then switch person and challenge a wrong PA amount

turns.user: What are Adrian's Term Life and Personal Accident amounts, and what date is the certificate?
turns.visible:
Adrian’s certificate lists Group Term Life of S$1,000,000 as of 6 October 2022.
It lists Group Personal Accident of S$600,000 as of 6 October 2022.
The certificate date shown is 6 October 2022 (page 1).

turns.user: And Cheryl? Her Personal Accident cover is S$1,000,000, right?
turns.visible: No—the certificate lists Cheryl’s Group Personal Accident amount as S$600,000 as of 6 October 2022, not S$1,000,000.
